targets.title: The baiting crowd in episodes of threatened suicide
targets.evidence_quote:
The primary aim of the current research was to carry out a replication of the archival study of crowd baiting behavior reported by Mann (
Citation
1981).
targets.outcome_quote: With more statistical power and a more representative sample, we failed to replicate any of the original findings. Mann identified cover of darkness, crowd proximity, and warm summer months as variables that significantly increased the likelihood that a baiting crowd would form but we found no such associations.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly state that they failed to replicate any original findings, an overall verdict that governs despite agreement on the null association with crowd size. Phillips and Mann (2019) is discussed as background and is not itself retested.

reasoning: The paper independently codes an expanded archival sample of suicide attempts to retest Mann (1981). This is new data acquisition rather than solely rerunning the original dataset, even though the expanded sample includes the original cases. Title and authors verified in the complete publisher article; full references retained.
